title: Criteria routes ConfigMap payload
description:
Operator configuration of record for Criteria workflow routing (CRI-216). The payload lives in the 'routes.json' data key of the 'criteria-routes' ConfigMap and is validated against this schema by k8s/tests/test_routes_config.sh.

Workflow routing follows ADR-0005's D1/D2 source model; the mode is declared, never inferred:

- type=image maps to D1 image-only: the workflow HCL is baked into 'image', nothing is fetched at run time, and declaring 'url' or 'ref' alongside it is rejected (D2 fail-closed: an image-only run must not carry a URL).
- type=url with no 'image' maps to D1 url-only: content is fetched from 'url' at run admission and executed on the minimal criteria/runtime base image.
- type=url plus 'image' maps to D1 url+image: the URL is the content, the image is the process (runtime + adapter set); the image never supplies workflow content.

'ref' is the operator-declared expected pin for fetched content; ADR-0005 D7 enforces it fail-closed at admission (criteria-side, CRI-223). Secret values must never appear here (plan CRI-214 section 3.8): secrets are referenced by SecretProviderClass name (OpenBao via the Secrets Store CSI driver).

workflowLibrary.description: Named workflow definitions routes may assign to tickets. Keys are the workflow names routes reference.

routes.description: Route entries assigning Linear tickets to workflow-library objects. Each ticket is matched by project, tag subset, and Linear workflow states.

label.description: DNS-1123 label (RFC 1123): lowercase alphanumeric or '-', max 63 characters.

envMap.description: Environment mapping: environment variable name to literal string value. For volume-scoped maps, values conventionally reference paths under the volume's mountPath.

workflow.description: A workflow-library object: how a run obtains its workflow (ADR-0005 D1/D2) and where/how it executes.

type.description: Workflow source type: 'image' (baked into the image, D1 image-only) or 'url' (fetched at admission, D1 url-only or url+image).

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace this workflow's runs are admitted into. Must match the namespace of this ConfigMap, the SecretProviderClasses, and the volumes it references.

image.description: Container image reference. Required for type=image (the trust anchor is the image itself, ADR-0005 D1). Optional for type=url, where setting it selects url+image (image = process, URL = content) and omitting it selects url-only on the minimal criteria/runtime base image.

url.description: Workflow source URL, fetched at run admission. Required for type=url (go-getter git/HTTP/archive/file forms, ADR-0005 D3 allowlist). Forbidden for type=image.

ref.description: Operator-declared expected immutable ref/digest pin for fetched (type=url) content, e.g. a git commit SHA or sha256:<hex> content digest. Enforced fail-closed at admission (ADR-0005 D7). Meaningless for type=image and rejected there.

volumes.description: Storage volumes the workflow's runs need. Names must be unique within the workflow.

secrets.description: Secrets the workflow's runs consume, referenced by SecretProviderClass name (OpenBao via the Secrets Store CSI driver). No credential material may appear here (plan CRI-214 section 3.8). Names must be unique within the workflow.

env.description: Static environment variables set on every run of this workflow.

then.description: D1 image-only: the image is the content and process trust anchor; a URL or a content pin must not be declared alongside it (D2 fail-closed).
D1 url-only (no image) or url+image (image set); the URL is required.

volume.description: A storage volume of kind pvc, nfs, or tmp, mounted into the workflow's runner at mountPath.

kind.description: Volume backing kind: pvc (PersistentVolumeClaim), nfs (network share), or tmp (emptyDir scratch).

subPath.description: Optional subdirectory of the volume to mount instead of its root.

readOnly.description: Mount the volume read-only. Defaults to false.

claim.description: pvc kind: name of the PersistentVolumeClaim (same namespace as the workflow).

server.description: nfs kind: NFS server hostname or address.

path.description: nfs kind: exported path on the NFS server.

sizeLimit.description: tmp kind: Kubernetes quantity sizing the emptyDir (e.g. 8Gi).

env.description: Environment mapping anchored on this volume: values conventionally reference paths under mountPath (e.g. CRITERIA_RUN_DIR_ROOT: /data/.criteria/runs).

secret.description: A secret the workflow's runs consume, mounted via the Secrets Store CSI driver from OpenBao and referenced by SecretProviderClass name. No credential material may appear here (plan CRI-214 section 3.8).

name.description: Logical name; unique within the workflow.

secretProviderClass.description: OpenBao/CSI name reference: name of the SecretProviderClass (secrets-store.csi.x-k8s.io, provider openbao) backing this secret.

mountPath.description: Absolute path where the CSI volume renders the SecretProviderClass objects as files.

env.description: Environment mapping for this secret: environment variable name to the key (rendered file) name within the SecretProviderClass mount. Names only — never secret values.

additionalProperties.description: Key (rendered file) name within the SecretProviderClass mount, e.g. linear_api_key.

route.description: A route entry assigning Linear tickets to a workflow-library object. Selection is by project, tag subset, and Linear workflow states.

name.description: Route name; unique within this ConfigMap.

workflow.description: Name of the workflow-library object this route assigns to matched tickets. Must exist in workflowLibrary.

project.description: Linear project name tickets must belong to (resolved by name, like the watcher's project today).

tags.description: Tag subset an issue's Linear labels must satisfy for this route to match. Empty or omitted matches any issue.

tagMatch.description: Subset semantics for 'tags': all = the issue's labels include every listed tag (default); any = the issue's labels include at least one listed tag.

states.description: Linear workflow state names a ticket must currently be in for this route to match (e.g. Triage). Omitted defaults to ["Triage"] (CRI-218, ADR-0005 §3.4); an explicit empty or null list is rejected, so author an explicit list to match any other state.
